nodes.name: Schedule Trigger (Every 5 Min)
nodes.notes: Executes continuous health checks every 5 minutes

nodes.name: Manual Health Check Webhook
nodes.notes: Allows manual on-demand health probes via cURL

nodes.name: Initialize Probe Configuration
nodes.notes: Captures start timestamp and target URL for latency calculation

nodes.name: Primary Health Check (Ping)
nodes.notes: Pings the monitored application; Continue On Fail ensures non-200 responses are captured

nodes.name: Calculate Latency & Health Check
nodes.notes: Calculates round-trip response time (ms) and determines status code

nodes.name: Is Application Healthy (200 OK)?
nodes.notes: Evaluates if application responded with HTTP 200

nodes.name: Log Healthy Heartbeat
nodes.notes: Records successful probe metric for health telemetry and daily summary

nodes.name: Wait 5 Seconds (Retry Buffer)
nodes.notes: Retry Logic: Pauses 5s before retrying to prevent false positives from transient packet drops

nodes.name: Retry Probe (Second Attempt)
nodes.notes: Secondary confirmation probe to verify outage persistence

nodes.name: Evaluate Retry Outcome
nodes.notes: Compares primary and secondary probe results

nodes.name: Outage Confirmed (Both Probes Failed)?
nodes.notes: Verifies that both probes failed before dispatching critical incident alert

nodes.name: Format Critical Outage Alert
nodes.notes: Constructs critical red Discord incident embed with diagnostic steps

nodes.name: Format Transient Flap Notice
nodes.notes: Constructs yellow recovery embed if retry succeeded

nodes.name: Post Critical Outage to Discord
nodes.notes: Dispatches critical outage notification to operations channel
